Proposed: Mainz
research:
The archival abstract names Hermann, scholaster of St. Maria ad gradus, instructing Rosdorf clergy about a tax assessment. His office and contemporaneous colleagues connect him with the same scholaster in 1444-07-06.json and 1457-04-30.json. Bauer (bauer_1872.json) could not place the 1452 scholaster and vicar general in the Franken genealogy and considered non-noble origin possible. The Mainz patrician family is another possibility, but no kinship links him to it. His Mainz office and surname alone do not distinguish either family. The 1449 archiepiscopal register corroborates his office and colleagues: https://www.ingrossaturbuecher.de/index.php?cHash=346098438fe451949fb23ed021a533c4&id=380&tx_hisodat_sources%5Baction%5D=show&tx_hisodat_sources%5Bcontroller%5D=Sources&tx_hisodat_sources%5Bsource%5D=22092. Attribution unresolved.

Further research supports Mainz. F. W. E. Roth identifies the Mariengreden scholaster as a member of the Mainz patrician Rosenberg family (Archiv für katholisches Kirchenrecht 80, 1900, pp. 189–192, https://archive.org/details/ArchivFuerKatholischesKirchenrecht1900/page/n191/mode/1up). The Erfurt matriculation of Easter 1425 groups Hermanus and Iacobus Rosenberg as de Maguncia (Weissenborn I, p. 131, https://archive.org/details/11698564bsb/page/n162/mode/1up). The Repertorium Academicum Germanicum lists Hermann as a Mainz patrician (https://resource.database.rag-online.org/ngLB2O476LT2xahbfLkaw). The Mainz register for the tax assessment matches the doctorate and office in Roth’s biography. Hermann’s exact kinship within the Mainz family remains open.

entries.german: Conrad Ruwe und Herman v. Buchenau Senioren und Domherren, Hermann v. Rosenberg Scholaster von St. Maria ad gradus, Sander von Martis Husen Cantor von St. Peter zu Mainz beauftragen Erzpriester, Kämmerer und Clerus des Sitzes Rosdorf, das Steuerausschreiben des Erzbischofs Dietrich von Mainz vom 1 März den Geistliches ihres Sitzes mitzutheilen.
entries.english: Conrad Ruwe and Herman von Buchenau, Seniors and Canons, Herman von Rosenberg, Scholaster of St. Maria ad gradus, Sander von Martis Husen, Cantor of St. Peter at Mainz, instruct the Archpriest, Chamberlain and Clergy of the Rosdorf seat to communicate Archbishop Dietrich of Mainz's tax assessment dated March 1 to the clergy of their district.

personTitle: Scholaster von St. Maria ad gradus
facts.content: instructed, with others, the archpriest, Kämmerer and clergy of Rosdorf to communicate Archbishop Dietrich of Mainz’s tax notice to the clergy of their district.
